note: BH-9065. The Fly guest size of a pool machine whose job kind VM_CLASS maps to `model` (a model session: lead review, re-review). Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.vm_size_model`. Allowed: performance-1x/2x/4x/8x/16x or shared-cpu-1x/2x/4x/8x (exact). A value outside the list, or a pair whose VM_MEMORY_MB_MODEL does not fit the size, launches performance-8x/16384 (class compute) and logs one `VM size row refused` line per spawn. Read only when VM_CLASS names a model kind.
